# CodingDatafy

> On a mission to build the world's largest reference and knowledge base for coding.

CodingDatafy is an open-source, edge-rendered developer reference platform providing distraction-free, privacy-first technical documentation across programming languages, frameworks, APIs, protocols, and databases.

## Core Reference Index
- [Homepage](https://www.codingdatafy.com/)
